items.html: And when Haman saw Mordechai, through whom there was illumination and providence over Israel at that time, he took counsel with Zeresh his wife and his 365 advisers, etc. And the Sages said that Zeresh his wife was a great sorceress, and her counsel was equal to all his 365 advisers. And their counsel rose to kill Mordechai and hang him on the tree — which is the tail of the snake, the continuation of the foot of the ape, as explained by us and as mentioned in the Zohar on Song of Songs. And this suffices.
